reason: I'd be interested because I'm tired all the time and I do want something that helps, but £24.99 for one jar of gummies feels like a lot when I'm on a tight budget and looking after Mum. I'd put my name on the waitlist for the 20% off and see what people say first.
objection: Does magnesium actually do anything for tiredness, and can I trust a brand I've never heard of? It says it works gradually over 30 to 60 days, so I'd be paying for weeks before I knew.
would_change_my_mind: Independent reviews from women my age who've been taking them for a month or two, showing they felt less tired, at a price nearer what I pay for my Boots vitamins.
